title: LlamaTree plugin manifest (plugin.json)
description: What a plugin tells LlamaTree about itself. The plugin's id is its folder's name: letters, digits and hyphens, which becomes its address (https://<id>.plugin.local/).

title.description: Shown in menus, on its tab and under Permissions.

description.description: One sentence on what it does.

version.description: Semantic version (major.minor.patch). Bump it with every change that ships; releases are tagged <id>-v<version>.

minAppVersion.description: The lowest LlamaTree version it works with; the app skips plugins that need a newer one.

entry.description: Its page, a file inside its folder (forward slashes).

icon.description: An image inside its folder (svg, png, ico, gif, jpg, jpeg or webp; 64 KB at most), shown beside its name.

placement.description: Where its page shows: a document tab, or a tab in the side panel beside Git Changes.

access.description: What it asks to see beyond its own page; the app asks the user before any is given. sessions: the sessions and their state; message: send messages to sessions and read their answers; ask: put a question about sessions to an agent (asked separately).

inbox.description: Whether sessions may message it first. Needs "message" access.

command.description: Sent to the plugin's page when the item is picked.

where.description: The menus it's on: palette (the palette button's Plugins section, the default), project (a project's right-click menu), session (a session's ⋯ menu) or sessionTab (a session tab's right-click menu).

toolbar.description: A button in the title bar: an icon from its folder, never text.
